عبد الرحمن بن يزيد بن جابر
عبد الرحمن بن يزيد بن جابر

notes: The opening «وقد روي هذا الحديث عن معاذ بن جبل» names a Companion already at the end of the main chain: left out.
«قال حدثنا خالد بن اللجلاج» is a second isnad after the matn carrying the same saying («فذكر الحديث»): its own group, not a variant.
Tirmidhi's remarks on Bishr b. Bakr, Walid b. Muslim and Walid's own route name other transmitters of the same saying: variant groups.
The praise and grading remarks and Bukhari's opinion are not chain links.
